description: The Sentinel/Executor — runs deterministic media-processing action chains (generation, ffmpeg/PIL post-processing, asset sync) dispatched by the Curriculum Agent. Not currently wired into the A2A runtime; this card is the governance contract required before any wiring.

capabilities.name: indii_image_gen
capabilities.description: Generate images via Imagen for curriculum-dispatched creative tasks.

capabilities.name: indii_video_gen
capabilities.description: Generate video via Veo for curriculum-dispatched creative tasks.

capabilities.name: indii_audio_ear
capabilities.description: Sonic analysis (BPM/key detection) used to sync generated media metadata to source audio.

capabilities.name: indii_oracle
capabilities.description: Aesthetic scoring / RIG evaluation of generated assets.

capabilities.name: google_file_search
capabilities.description: RAG / technical retrieval over project files.

capabilities.name: indii_sync
capabilities.description: Roadie distribution sync of finished assets.

capabilities.name: media_postprocess_terminal
capabilities.description: Terminal media post-processing (ffmpeg conversions/crops, PIL image manipulation) scoped to the project workspace. This capability is why the card is riskTier destructive.

blockedActions: delete files outside the project workspace
overwrite source/master audio or video assets
execute terminal commands unrelated to media processing
modify repository code, configs, or credentials
publish or distribute assets without an approved indii_sync dispatch
